3 BHK in Victory Valley: questions buyers ask

What is the rent of a 3 BHK in IREO Victory Valley?

3 BHK flats for rent in IREO Victory Valley are listed between ₹80,000/month and ₹1,25,000/month, averaging ₹89,842/month. Rents depend on floor, view, tower and condition.

What is the size of a 3 BHK in IREO Victory Valley?

Advertised 3 BHK flats measure 2,400–3,337 sq ft (super area). Most include a servant room.

How many 3 BHK flats are available for rent?

31 as of 31 Oct 2026. The list on this page is refreshed as new advertisements come in and sold flats are removed.

Can I see photos or a video before visiting?

Yes. Tap Enquire on any flat and Family&Flats will share photos and a short video on WhatsApp, usually within 24 hours, before you plan a visit.

Is the rent negotiable?

No. These are asking rents from the market (₹80,000–1,25,000/month). 2 listings have already reduced the price. The final rent depends on furnishing, lease length and move-in date; Family&Flats shares recent deal context and negotiates on your behalf.

Is IREO Victory Valley ready to move?

Yes. IREO Victory Valley on Golf Course Extension Road is a completed, ready-to-move project, so you can move in as soon as the lease is signed.
